title: Controls and feature usability confusion
summary: This topic is loosely clustered around unclear controls and unavailable functions, with many fragments too context-poor to determine a clear overall sentiment.

negative.summary: The negative review says the vehicle’s signals are hard to understand, pointing to confusing feedback from the interface or controls.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews describe uncertainty about whether a feature is good or bad and awkward touch controls that make it hard to confirm whether an input registered.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention diverse issues such as climate and heater controls, app limitations, window closing, airflow adjustment, dealer inability to help, and buttons that do not clearly show activation, but the examples are too fragmented to summarize more confidently.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined and are too brief or context-limited for a firm sentiment reading.
This cluster mixes several possibly unrelated subjects, including interface feedback, climate controls, app capabilities, dealer support, and towing-related usability.
The sampled fragments are stratified and not representative of all reviews on this topic.
